semantic.justification: AQF9AG ports consumed UnicodeString owned UTF-16 constructors/copy/bogus/scalar/equality and whole-value append/operator+ projection for timezone rule names. Append preserves a bogus receiver and ignores empty/bogus source text; concat constructs a fresh owner and appends both, so a bogus zero-length prefix does not propagate to the result. IDs, lone surrogate/NUL units and name copies retain exact code units. JS immutable strings/GC project owned value state without native buffers, aliases, capacity, allocation failure, COW/refcounts or ABI guarantees. Native scalar identity and actual transition-name probes plus unit tests cover the stated value slice. Source whole-string compare and const getBuffer now preserve bogus ordering, UTF16 code-unit order and borrowed embedded-NUL spans. Native system-ID lookup and canonical-cache comparisons cover their consumed uses; writable buffer/capacity/native ownership APIs remain unported. Consumed remove clears bogus state, and char32At follows source U16_GET to decode pairs from either lead or trail positions. UTF16 input spans and source integer parsing retain CALC-315 instead of advancing by code point. Original raw RBBIDataWrapper constructors now create actual borrowed header/table/trie/status views and owned rule strings, preserving initialization/error/version/width order, byte equality/hash, same-owner references and failed-init counter behavior. Native comparison matches 189 full initialized-field/array/reference/equality traces, including adopted/borrowed/embedded storage and 8/16/32-bit trie paths. Fresh UnicodeString::fromUTF8 uses the actual ICU converter and the existing managed UTF16 value binding; 65536 byte-pair values and 213 counted/null/long values match the original class. No public writable-buffer/alias allocator API, replacement UDataMemory owner, iterator or engine factory is supplied. Actual UDataMemory construction/loader, public iterator/engines and word/title/UNO/NatNum12 installation remain pending; native allocation/deletion/COW/thread/physical ABI and use after final release remain unverified. Source UnicodeString counted code-point movement and count preserve UTF-16 limits and supplementary stepping used by CjkBreakEngine.
